﻿/**
 * 报表服务：甘特数据 / 燃尽图 / 成员负载热力图（§4.3 Phase 2 B16）。
 * 轻量 CPM 实现：基于 TaskDependency + Task 的 ES/EF 推算，周末顺延、durationDays=estimatedHours/8。
 * 租户铁律：所有查询带 tenantId 谓词。
 */
import { Injectable, Logger, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { Response } from 'express';
import { PrismaService } from '../../common/prisma/prisma.service';
import { AuthUser } from '../../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { detectOverlaps, type TaskForOverlap, type DependencyForOverlap } from './overlap/overlap-detector';
 
const E = { NOT_FOUND: 40401, FORBIDDEN: 40301 } as const;
 
/** 工作日偏移：跳过周六日（简单实现） */
function addWorkdays(start: Date, days: number): Date {
  const d = new Date(start);
  let added = 0;
  while (added < days) {
    d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1);
    const dow = d.getUTCDay();
    if (dow !== 0 && dow !== 6) added++;
  }
  return d;
}
 
/** 两个日期之间的工作日差 */
function workdayDiff(a: Date, b: Date): number {
  if (a.getTime() > b.getTime()) return -workdayDiff(b, a);
  let diff = 0;
  const cur = new Date(a);
  while (cur.getTime() < b.getTime()) {
    cur.setUTCDate(cur.getUTCDate() + 1);
    const dow = cur.getUTCDay();
    if (dow !== 0 && dow !== 6) diff++;
  }
  return diff;
}
 
/** 日期 YYYY-MM-DD 格式 */
function toYMD(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
 
/** 保留 n 位小数 */
function roundTo(n: number, digits: number): number {
  const factor = Math.pow(10, digits);
  return Math.round(n * factor) / factor;
}
 
/** 任务状态过滤谓词（not done/cancelled） */
const ACTIVE_STATUS_IN: string[] = ['todo', 'in_progress', 'blocked'];
 
@Injectable()
export class ReportsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ReportsService.name);
 
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
 
  // ===================== 项目可见性 =====================
 
  private async assertProjectVisible(projectId: string, user: AuthUser): Promise<void> {
    const project = await this.prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: { id: projectId, tenantId: user.tenantId, deletedAt: null },
    });
    if (!project) throw new NotFoundException({ code: E.NOT_FOUND, message: '项目不存在或不可见' });
    // 简单权限检查：项目负责人、租户 admin 或项目成员均可查看报表
    if (project.ownerId === user.userId) return;
    if (user.roles.some(r => r.scope === 'tenant' && (r.key === 'tenant.owner' || r.key === 'tenant.admin'))) return;
    const member = await this.prisma.userRole.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, userId: user.userId, scopeResourceId: projectId, role: { scope: 'project' } },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (!member) throw new NotFoundException({ code: E.NOT_FOUND, message: '项目不存在或不可见' });
  }
 
  // ===================== 甘特数据 =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/gantt
   * 返回甘特行数据（任务 + 依赖 + ES/EF 窗口），前端直接画。
   */
  async getGantt(projectId: string, user: AuthUser, assigneeId?: string) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
 
    // 加载任务 + 依赖
    const [tasks, deps] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.task.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId: user.tenantId,
          projectId,
          deletedAt: null,
          ...(assigneeId ? { assigneeId } : {}),
        },
        orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        include: { dependenciesOut: { where: { tenantId: user.tenantId } } },
      }),
      this.prisma.taskDependency.findMany({
        where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId },
      }),
    ]);
 
    const taskMap = new Map<string, typeof tasks[0]>();
    for (const t of tasks) taskMap.set(t.id, t);
 
    // CPM 计算（轻量版）
    const cpmTasks = this.computeCPM(tasks, deps, user.tenantId);
 
    // 计算时间窗口
    const allDates = cpmTasks.flatMap(t => [new Date(t.es), new Date(t.ef)]);
    const windowStart = allDates.length ? new Date(Math.min(...allDates.map(d => d.getTime()))) : new Date();
    const windowEnd = allDates.length ? new Date(Math.max(...allDates.map(d => d.getTime()))) : new Date();
    // 扩展窗口各 2 天
    windowStart.setUTCDate(windowStart.getUTCDate() - 2);
    windowEnd.setUTCDate(windowEnd.getUTCDate() + 2);
 
    // 构建行数据
    const rows = tasks.map(task => {
      const cpm = cpmTasks.find(c => c.id === task.id);
      const start = cpm?.es ? new Date(cpm.es) : new Date();
      const end = cpm?.ef ? new Date(cpm.ef) : new Date();
      const dependencies = task.dependenciesOut.map(d => d.nextTaskId);
      const progress = task.status === 'done' ? 100 : task.status === 'in_progress' ? 50 : 0;
      const isMilestone = cpm?.milestone ?? false;
 
      return {
        taskId: task.id,
        title: task.title,
        status: task.status,
        assigneeId: task.assigneeId,
        start: start.toISOString(),
        end: end.toISOString(),
        progress,
        critical: cpm?.critical ?? false,
        milestone: isMilestone,
        dependencies,
      };
    });
 
    return {
      data: {
        projectId,
        window: {
          start: windowStart.toISOString(),
          end: windowEnd.toISOString(),
        },
        rows,
      },
    };
  }
 
  // ===================== 燃尽图 =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/burndown?days=14
   * 每日窗口内剩余任务数与已完成数累计。
   */
  async getBurndown(projectId: string, user: AuthUser, days: number) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
 
    const now = new Date();
    const startDate = new Date(now);
    startDate.setUTCDate(startDate.getUTCDate() - days + 1);
    startDate.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
 
    const allTasks = await this.prisma.task.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null },
      select: { id: true, status: true, completedAt: true, createdAt: true },
    });
 
    const totalActive = allTasks.filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status)).length;
    const baseline = totalActive;
 
    const points = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
      const date = new Date(startDate);
      date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + i);
      const dateStr = toYMD(date);
      const nextDay = new Date(date);
      nextDay.setUTCDate(nextDay.getUTCDate() + 1);
 
      const remaining = allTasks.filter(t => {
        if (['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status)) return false;
        const created = new Date(t.createdAt);
        return created <= nextDay;
      }).length;
 
      const completed = allTasks.filter(t => {
        if (t.status !== 'done' || !t.completedAt) return false;
        const completedDate = new Date(t.completedAt);
        return completedDate <= nextDay && completedDate >= date;
      }).length;
 
      // 累计已完成
      const cumulativeCompleted = allTasks.filter(t => {
        if (t.status !== 'done' || !t.completedAt) return false;
        const completedDate = new Date(t.completedAt);
        return completedDate <= nextDay;
      }).length;
 
      points.push({
        date: dateStr,
        remaining,
        completed: cumulativeCompleted,
        baseline,
      });
    }
 
    return {
      data: {
        projectId,
        days,
        points,
      },
    };
  }
 
  // ===================== 成员负载热力图 =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/load?projectId=&days=14
   * 成员维度每日任务数与时数。
   */
  async getLoad(user: AuthUser, projectId?: string, days?: number) {
    const actualDays = days ?? 14;
    const now = new Date();
    const startDate = new Date(now);
    startDate.setUTCDate(startDate.getUTCDate() - actualDays + 1);
    startDate.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
 
    // 确定要查询的项目
    const targetProjectIds = projectId
      ? [projectId]
      : (await this.prisma.project.findMany({
          where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, deletedAt: null },
          select: { id: true },
        })).map(p => p.id);
 
    // 获取所有相关任务（未完成的）
    const allTasks = await this.prisma.task.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        projectId: { in: targetProjectIds },
        deletedAt: null,
        status: { notIn: ['done', 'cancelled'] },
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        assigneeId: true,
        estimatedHours: true,
        dueAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
        projectId: true,
      },
    });
 
    // 获取成员信息
    const memberIds = [...new Set(allTasks.map(t => t.assigneeId).filter(Boolean) as string[])];
    const members = memberIds.length > 0
      ? await this.prisma.user.findMany({
          where: { id: { in: memberIds } },
          select: { id: true, displayName: true },
        })
      : [];
    const memberMap = new Map(members.map(m => [m.id, m.displayName]));
 
    // 按成员聚合每日负载
    const memberLoads = new Map<string, { date: string; taskCount: number; hours: number }[]>();
 
    for (let i = 0; i < actualDays; i++) {
      const date = new Date(startDate);
      date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + i);
      const dateStr = toYMD(date);
 
      for (const task of allTasks) {
        if (!task.assigneeId) continue;
        // 判断任务是否应计入该天（dueAt 落在当天，或无 dueAt 则按 createdAt 估算）
        let relevantDate: Date | null = null;
        if (task.dueAt) {
          relevantDate = new Date(task.dueAt);
        } else {
          relevantDate = new Date(task.createdAt);
        }
        if (relevantDate && toYMD(relevantDate) === dateStr) {
          if (!memberLoads.has(task.assigneeId)) {
            memberLoads.set(task.assigneeId, []);
          }
          const loads = memberLoads.get(task.assigneeId)!;
          const existing = loads.find(l => l.date === dateStr);
          if (existing) {
            existing.taskCount += 1;
            existing.hours = Math.round(((existing.hours as number) + (task.estimatedHours?.toNumber() ?? 0)) * 10) / 10;
          } else {
            loads.push({
              date: dateStr,
              taskCount: 1,
              hours: task.estimatedHours?.toNumber() ?? 0,
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
 
    const resultMembers = Array.from(memberLoads.entries()).map(([userId, loads]) => ({
      userId,
      displayName: memberMap.get(userId) ?? userId.slice(0, 8),
      loads,
    }));
 
    return {
      data: {
        days: actualDays,
        start: toYMD(startDate),
        members: resultMembers,
      },
    };
  }
 
  // ===================== CPM 计算（轻量版） =====================
 
  /**
   * 关键路径法（CPM）：基于依赖关系计算最早/最晚开始时间。
   * 工期 = estimatedHours / 8（工作日），无估时默认 1 天。
   * 起点：无前置依赖的任务从今天开始；周末顺延。
   */
  private computeCPM(
    tasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string; estimatedHours: Prisma.Decimal | number | null | undefined; createdAt: Date }>,
    deps: Array<{ id: string; prevTaskId: string; nextTaskId: string; type: string; lagDays: number }>,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Array<{ id: string; es: string; ef: string; ls: string; lf: string; slackDays: number; critical: boolean; milestone: boolean }> {
    // 过滤掉已完成/已取消的任务
    const activeTasks = tasks.filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status));
    const activeIds = new Set(activeTasks.map(t => t.id));
 
    // 构建依赖图（只保留活跃任务间的依赖）
    const adjList = new Map<string, Array<{ nextId: string; type: string; lagDays: number }>>();
    const inDegree = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const t of activeTasks) {
      adjList.set(t.id, []);
      inDegree.set(t.id, 0);
    }
    for (const dep of deps) {
      if (!activeIds.has(dep.prevTaskId) || !activeIds.has(dep.nextTaskId)) continue;
      adjList.get(dep.prevTaskId)!.push({ nextId: dep.nextTaskId, type: dep.type, lagDays: dep.lagDays });
      inDegree.set(dep.nextTaskId, (inDegree.get(dep.nextTaskId) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
 
    // 计算每个任务的工期（工作日）
    const durationMap = new Map<string, number>();
    const today = new Date();
    today.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (const t of activeTasks) {
      const hours = t.estimatedHours ? (t.estimatedHours instanceof Number ? t.estimatedHours : (t.estimatedHours as Prisma.Decimal)?.toNumber?.() ?? (t.estimatedHours as number)) : null;
      const days = hours ? Math.ceil((hours as number) / 8) : 1;
      durationMap.set(t.id, Math.max(1, days));
    }
 
    // 拓扑排序 + ES/EF 正向传播
    const esMap = new Map<string, Date>();
    const efMap = new Map<string, Date>();
    const queue: string[] = [];
 
    for (const [id, deg] of inDegree) {
      if (deg === 0) {
        queue.push(id);
        esMap.set(id, new Date(today));
      }
    }
 
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const current = queue.shift()!;
      const es = esMap.get(current)!;
      const dur = durationMap.get(current) ?? 1;
      const ef = addWorkdays(es, dur);
      efMap.set(current, ef);
 
      for (const { nextId, type, lagDays } of adjList.get(current) ?? []) {
        // 根据依赖类型计算 next 的 ES
        let nextEs: Date;
        switch (type) {
          case 'FS': // 完成-开始：前置 EF + lagDays
            nextEs = addWorkdays(ef, lagDays);
            break;
          case 'SS': // 开始-开始：前置 ES + lagDays
            nextEs = addWorkdays(es, lagDays);
            break;
          case 'FF': // 完成-完成：前置 EF + lagDays 后任务 EF
            // 特殊处理：FF 依赖影响 EF，这里简化为 ES 也受影响
            nextEs = addWorkdays(ef, lagDays);
            break;
          case 'SF': // 开始-完成：前置 ES + lagDays 后任务 ES
            nextEs = addWorkdays(es, lagDays);
            break;
          default:
            nextEs = addWorkdays(ef, lagDays);
        }
 
        // 更新 ES（取最大值）
        const existingEs = esMap.get(nextId);
        if (!existingEs || nextEs.getTime() > existingEs.getTime()) {
          esMap.set(nextId, nextEs);
        }
 
        inDegree.set(nextId, (inDegree.get(nextId) ?? 1) - 1);
        if ((inDegree.get(nextId) ?? 0) === 0) {
          queue.push(nextId);
        }
      }
    }
 
    // 计算 EF（如果还没设置）
    for (const t of activeTasks) {
      if (!efMap.has(t.id)) {
        const es = esMap.get(t.id) ?? today;
        efMap.set(t.id, addWorkdays(es, durationMap.get(t.id) ?? 1));
      }
    }
 
    // 反向传播：LF/LS
    const lfMap = new Map<string, Date>();
    const lsMap = new Map<string, Date>();
 
    // 找到最大 EF
    let maxEf = today;
    for (const ef of efMap.values()) {
      if (ef.getTime() > maxEf.getTime()) maxEf = ef;
    }
 
    // 逆向拓扑
    const reverseAdj = new Map<string, Array<string>>();
    for (const dep of deps) {
      if (!activeIds.has(dep.prevTaskId) || !activeIds.has(dep.nextTaskId)) continue;
      if (!reverseAdj.has(dep.nextTaskId)) reverseAdj.set(dep.nextTaskId, []);
      reverseAdj.get(dep.nextTaskId)!.push(dep.prevTaskId);
    }
 
    // 从 EF 最大的任务开始反向
    const sortedByEf = [...activeTasks].sort((a, b) => {
      const efA = efMap.get(a.id)?.getTime() ?? 0;
      const efB = efMap.get(b.id)?.getTime() ?? 0;
      return efB - efA;
    });
 
    for (const t of sortedByEf) {
      const ef = efMap.get(t.id)!;
      const successors = reverseAdj.get(t.id) ?? [];
 
      if (successors.length === 0) {
        // 没有后置任务，LF = EF
        lfMap.set(t.id, ef);
      } else {
        // LF = min(前置任务的 LS)，考虑依赖类型
        let minLs = ef;
        for (const prevId of successors) {
          const dep = deps.find(d => d.prevTaskId === prevId && d.nextTaskId === t.id);
          if (!dep) continue;
          const prevEf = efMap.get(prevId)!;
          let prevLs: Date;
          switch (dep.type) {
            case 'FS':
              prevLs = addWorkdays(minLs, -dep.lagDays);
              break;
            case 'SS':
              prevLs = addWorkdays(minLs, -dep.lagDays);
              break;
            case 'FF':
              prevLs = addWorkdays(minLs, -dep.lagDays);
              break;
            case 'SF':
              prevLs = addWorkdays(minLs, -dep.lagDays);
              break;
            default:
              prevLs = addWorkdays(minLs, -dep.lagDays);
          }
          if (prevLs.getTime() < minLs.getTime()) minLs = prevLs;
        }
        lfMap.set(t.id, minLs);
      }
 
      const dur = durationMap.get(t.id) ?? 1;
      lsMap.set(t.id, addWorkdays(lfMap.get(t.id)!, -dur));
    }
 
    // 计算 slack 和 critical
    const result = activeTasks.map(t => {
      const es = esMap.get(t.id) ?? today;
      const ef = efMap.get(t.id) ?? es;
      const ls = lsMap.get(t.id) ?? es;
      const lf = lfMap.get(t.id) ?? ef;
      const slackDays = workdayDiff(es, ls);
      const isCritical = slackDays === 0;
      // 里程碑：关键路径上且 dueAt 非空，或 durationDays === 0
      const isMilestone = isCritical && !!t.estimatedHours && (t.estimatedHours as number) === 0;
      return {
        id: t.id,
        es: es.toISOString(),
        ef: ef.toISOString(),
        ls: ls.toISOString(),
        lf: lf.toISOString(),
        slackDays,
        critical: isCritical,
        milestone: isMilestone,
      };
    });
 
    return result;
  }
 
  // ====================================================================
  // B18 周报 + 仪表盘 + CSV 导出
  // ====================================================================
 
  // ===================== 周日期工具 =====================
 
  /** 获取指定日期所在周的周一（UTC 00:00） */
  private getMondayOfWeek(date: Date): Date {
    const d = new Date(date);
    d.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const dow = d.getUTCDay();
    const diff = dow === 0 ? -6 : 1 - dow; // 周日(0)往前 6 天到周一
    d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + diff);
    return d;
  }
 
  /** 解析 weekStart（YYYY-MM-DD），非法则回退本周一 */
  private parseWeekStart(weekStart?: string): Date {
    if (!weekStart) return this.getMondayOfWeek(new Date());
    const d = new Date(weekStart + 'T00:00:00.000Z');
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return this.getMondayOfWeek(new Date());
    return this.getMondayOfWeek(d);
  }
 
  // ===================== 周报生成 =====================
 
  /**
   * POST /reports/projects/:projectId/weekly-report
   * 确定性模板周报（无 LLM）：summary + memberBreakdown + highlights + risks
   */
  async generateWeeklyReport(projectId: string, user: AuthUser, weekStart?: string) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
 
    const start = this.parseWeekStart(weekStart);
    const end = new Date(start);
    end.setUTCDate(end.getUTCDate() + 7);
    const startStr = toYMD(start);
    const endStr = toYMD(end);
 
    // 窗口内相关任务
    const tasks = await this.prisma.task.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        projectId,
        deletedAt: null,
      },
      select: {
        id: true, title: true, status: true, assigneeId: true,
        dueAt: true, createdAt: true, completedAt: true,
        estimatedHours: true,
      },
    });
 
    // 窗口内工时
    const timeEntries = await this.prisma.timeEntry.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        task: { projectId, deletedAt: null },
        startedAt: { gte: start, lt: end },
      },
      select: { taskId: true, userId: true, durationSeconds: true, startedAt: true },
    });
 
    // 成员姓名
    const memberIds = new Set<string>();
    tasks.forEach(t => t.assigneeId && memberIds.add(t.assigneeId));
    timeEntries.forEach(t => memberIds.add(t.userId));
    const members = memberIds.size > 0 ? await this.prisma.user.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: [...memberIds] } },
      select: { id: true, displayName: true },
    }) : [];
    const nameMap = new Map(members.map(m => [m.id, m.displayName]))
 
    // 计算 summary
    const inWindow = (d: Date | string | null) => d != null && new Date(d).getTime() >= start.getTime() && new Date(d).getTime() < end.getTime();
 
    const newTasks = tasks.filter(t => inWindow(t.createdAt)).length;
    const completedTasks = tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'done' && inWindow(t.completedAt)).length;
    const cancelledTasks = tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'cancelled' && inWindow(t.completedAt)).length;
    const overdueTasks = tasks.filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status) && t.dueAt && new Date(t.dueAt).getTime() < end.getTime()).length;
    const totalTasks = tasks.length;
 
    const totalSeconds = timeEntries.reduce((s, t) => s + (t.durationSeconds ?? 0), 0);
    const totalActualHours = roundTo(totalSeconds / 3600, 2);
 
    const estimatedHoursSum = tasks
      .filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status) || inWindow(t.completedAt))
      .reduce((s, t) => s + (t.estimatedHours?.toNumber?.() ?? 0), 0);
    const totalEstimatedHours = roundTo(estimatedHoursSum, 2);
 
    const denom = tasks.filter(t => t.status !== 'cancelled').length;
    const completionRate = denom > 0 ? roundTo(completedTasks / denom, 4) : 0;
 
    const doneWithDue = tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'done' && inWindow(t.completedAt) && t.dueAt);
    const onTimeCount = doneWithDue.filter(t => t.completedAt && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() <= new Date(t.dueAt!).getTime()).length;
    const onTimeRate = doneWithDue.length > 0 ? roundTo(onTimeCount / doneWithDue.length, 4) : null;
 
    // memberBreakdown
    const memberMap = new Map<string, { completedCount: number; actualSeconds: number; estimatedHours: number }>();
    for (const tid of memberIds) {
      memberMap.set(tid, { completedCount: 0, actualSeconds: 0, estimatedHours: 0 });
    }
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (t.status === 'done' && inWindow(t.completedAt) && t.assigneeId) {
        const m = memberMap.get(t.assigneeId);
        if (m) m.completedCount += 1;
      }
      if (t.assigneeId) {
        const m = memberMap.get(t.assigneeId);
        if (m && (!['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status) || inWindow(t.completedAt))) {
          m.estimatedHours += t.estimatedHours?.toNumber?.() ?? 0;
        }
      }
    });
    timeEntries.forEach(t => {
      const m = memberMap.get(t.userId);
      if (m) m.actualSeconds += t.durationSeconds ?? 0;
    });
 
    const memberBreakdown = [...memberMap.entries()]
      .map(([userId, m]) => ({
        userId,
        displayName: nameMap.get(userId) ?? userId.slice(0, 8),
        completedCount: m.completedCount,
        actualHours: roundTo(m.actualSeconds / 3600, 2),
        estimatedHours: roundTo(m.estimatedHours, 2),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.completedCount - a.completedCount || a.userId.localeCompare(b.userId));
 
    // highlights（确定性规则）
    const highlights: string[] = [];
    if (completedTasks >= 5) highlights.push(`本周完成 ${completedTasks} 项任务`);
    else if (completedTasks > 0) highlights.push(`本周完成 ${completedTasks} 项任务`);
    if (onTimeRate != null && onTimeRate >= 0.8) highlights.push(`准时率 ${Math.round(onTimeRate * 100)}%`);
    if (newTasks > 0) highlights.push(`新增 ${newTasks} 项任务`);
    if (totalActualHours > 0) highlights.push(`累计工时 ${totalActualHours} 小时`);
 
    // risks（确定性规则）
    const risks: string[] = [];
    if (overdueTasks > 0) risks.push(`${overdueTasks} 项任务已逾期`);
    if (onTimeRate != null && onTimeRate < 0.6 && doneWithDue.length >= 3) risks.push(`准时率偏低（${Math.round(onTimeRate * 100)}%）`);
    const nextWeekActive = tasks.filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status)).length;
    const nextWeekEstimate = tasks.filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status)).reduce((s, t) => s + (t.estimatedHours?.toNumber?.() ?? 0), 0);
    if (nextWeekEstimate > 40) risks.push(`下周未完成任务估时合计较高（${roundTo(nextWeekEstimate, 1)} 小时，${nextWeekActive} 项）`);
 
    return {
      data: {
        projectId,
        weekStart: startStr,
        weekEnd: endStr,
        summary: {
          totalTasks, completedTasks, cancelledTasks, newTasks, overdueTasks,
          totalActualHours, totalEstimatedHours, completionRate, onTimeRate,
        },
        memberBreakdown,
        highlights,
        risks,
        generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        isTemplate: true,
      },
    };
  }
 
  // ===================== 周报列表（回溯生成） =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/weekly-reports?limit=10
   * 按周回溯生成最近 N 周的摘要（即时计算，不落库）。
   */
  async listWeeklyReports(projectId: string, user: AuthUser, limit: number) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
    const reports = [];
    const thisMonday = this.getMondayOfWeek(new Date());
 
    for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
      const start = new Date(thisMonday);
      start.setUTCDate(start.getUTCDate() - i * 7);
      const end = new Date(start);
      end.setUTCDate(end.getUTCDate() + 7);
 
      const [completedCount, newCount, overdueCount] = await Promise.all([
        this.prisma.task.count({
          where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null, status: 'done', completedAt: { gte: start, lt: end } },
        }),
        this.prisma.task.count({
          where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null, createdAt: { gte: start, lt: end } },
        }),
        this.prisma.task.count({
          where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null, status: { notIn: ['done', 'cancelled'] }, dueAt: { lt: end } },
        }),
      ]);
 
      reports.push({
        weekStart: toYMD(start),
        summary: { completedTasks: completedCount, newTasks: newCount, overdueTasks: overdueCount },
        generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }
 
    return { data: { projectId, reports } };
  }
 
  // ===================== 项目仪表盘 =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/dashboard
   * 项目全量统计 + 4 周趋势 + 状态分布 + Top-5 成员。
   */
  async getDashboard(projectId: string, user: AuthUser) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
 
    const tasks = await this.prisma.task.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null },
      select: { id: true, status: true, assigneeId: true, dueAt: true, createdAt: true, completedAt: true, estimatedHours: true },
    });
 
    // 本周窗口
    const thisMonday = this.getMondayOfWeek(new Date());
    const nextMonday = new Date(thisMonday);
    nextMonday.setUTCDate(nextMonday.getUTCDate() + 7);
 
    const completedThisWeek = tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() >= thisMonday.getTime() && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() < nextMonday.getTime()).length;
    const overdueTasks = tasks.filter(t => !['done', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status) && t.dueAt && new Date(t.dueAt).getTime() < nextMonday.getTime()).length;
    const activeTasks = tasks.filter(t => ['todo', 'in_progress', 'blocked'].includes(t.status)).length;
 
    const assigneeIds = [...new Set(tasks.map(t => t.assigneeId).filter(Boolean) as string[])];
    const totalMembers = assigneeIds.length;
 
    // 本周工时
    const timeEntries = await this.prisma.timeEntry.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, task: { projectId, deletedAt: null }, startedAt: { gte: thisMonday, lt: nextMonday } },
      select: { durationSeconds: true, startedAt: true, userId: true },
    });
    const totalActualHoursThisWeek = roundTo(timeEntries.reduce((s, t) => s + (t.durationSeconds ?? 0), 0) / 3600, 2);
 
    // 4 周完成趋势
    const completionTrend: { week: string; completedCount: number }[] = [];
    const hoursTrend: { week: string; hours: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 3; i >= 0; i--) {
      const wStart = new Date(thisMonday);
      wStart.setUTCDate(wStart.getUTCDate() - i * 7);
      const wEnd = new Date(wStart);
      wEnd.setUTCDate(wEnd.getUTCDate() + 7);
      const week = toYMD(wStart);
 
      const weekCompleted = tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() >= wStart.getTime() && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() < wEnd.getTime()).length;
      completionTrend.push({ week, completedCount: weekCompleted });
 
      const weekSeconds = timeEntries.filter(t => new Date(t.startedAt).getTime() >= wStart.getTime() && new Date(t.startedAt).getTime() < wEnd.getTime())
        .reduce((s, t) => s + (t.durationSeconds ?? 0), 0);
      hoursTrend.push({ week, hours: roundTo(weekSeconds / 3600, 1) });
    }
 
    // 状态分布
    const statusDistribution = { todo: 0, in_progress: 0, blocked: 0, done: 0, cancelled: 0 } as Record<string, number>;
    tasks.forEach(t => { if (statusDistribution[t.status] != null) statusDistribution[t.status]++; });
 
    // Top-5 成员（本周完成数降序）
    const memberCounts = new Map<string, { completedCount: number; actualSeconds: number }>();
    assigneeIds.forEach(id => memberCounts.set(id, { completedCount: 0, actualSeconds: 0 }));
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt && t.assigneeId && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() >= thisMonday.getTime() && new Date(t.completedAt).getTime() < nextMonday.getTime()) {
        const m = memberCounts.get(t.assigneeId);
        if (m) m.completedCount++;
      }
    });
    timeEntries.forEach(t => {
      const m = memberCounts.get(t.userId);
      if (m) m.actualSeconds += t.durationSeconds ?? 0;
    });
    const members = assigneeIds.length > 0 ? await this.prisma.user.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: assigneeIds } },
      select: { id: true, displayName: true },
    }) : [];
    const nameMap2 = new Map(members.map(m => [m.id, m.displayName]));
    const topMembers = [...memberCounts.entries()]
      .map(([userId, m]) => ({
        userId,
        displayName: nameMap2.get(userId) ?? userId.slice(0, 8),
        completedCount: m.completedCount,
        actualHours: roundTo(m.actualSeconds / 3600, 2),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.completedCount - a.completedCount)
      .slice(0, 5);
 
    return {
      data: {
        projectId,
        stats: {
          totalTasks: tasks.length,
          activeTasks,
          completedThisWeek,
          overdueTasks,
          totalMembers,
          totalActualHoursThisWeek,
        },
        trends: { completionTrend, hoursTrend },
        statusDistribution,
        topMembers,
      },
    };
  }
 
  // ===================== CSV 导出 =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/export?format=csv
   * 导出任务列表 CSV 流（v1 仅 csv）。
   * 列：taskId,title,status,assignee,estimatedHours,actualHours,startedAt,dueAt,completedAt,dependencies
   */
  async exportCsv(projectId: string, user: AuthUser, format: 'csv' | undefined, res: Response) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
 
    const tasks = await this.prisma.task.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null },
      orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      include: {
        dependenciesIn: { where: { tenantId: user.tenantId }, select: { prevTaskId: true } },
      },
    });
 
    // 计算每个任务 actualHours
    const timeAgg = await this.prisma.timeEntry.groupBy({
      by: ['taskId'],
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, task: { projectId, deletedAt: null } },
      _sum: { durationSeconds: true },
    });
    const actualMap = new Map(timeAgg.map(t => [t.taskId, (t._sum.durationSeconds ?? 0) / 3600]));
 
    // 成员姓名
    const assigneeIds = [...new Set(tasks.map(t => t.assigneeId).filter(Boolean) as string[])];
    const members = assigneeIds.length > 0 ? await this.prisma.user.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: assigneeIds } },
      select: { id: true, displayName: true },
    }) : [];
    const nameMap3 = new Map(members.map(m => [m.id, m.displayName]));
 
    const escapeCsv = (v: any) => {
      if (v == null) return '';
      const s = String(v);
      if (s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n')) {
        return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
      }
      return s;
    };
    const fmtDate = (d: Date | null | undefined) => d ? toYMD(new Date(d)) : '';
 
    const lines = ['taskId,title,status,assignee,estimatedHours,actualHours,startedAt,dueAt,completedAt,dependencies'];
    for (const t of tasks) {
      const deps = t.dependenciesIn.map(d => d.prevTaskId).join(';');
      lines.push([
        t.id,
        t.title,
        t.status,
        nameMap3.get(t.assigneeId!) ?? '',
        t.estimatedHours?.toString() ?? '',
        actualMap.get(t.id)?.toFixed(2) ?? '0',
        fmtDate(t.startedAt),
        fmtDate(t.dueAt),
        fmtDate(t.completedAt),
        deps,
      ].map(escapeCsv).join(','));
    }
 
    const csv = lines.join('\n');
    const fileName = `project_${projectId}_${toYMD(new Date())}.csv`;
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/csv; charset=utf-8');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${fileName}"`);
    res.send('\ufeff' + csv); // BOM 兼容 Excel
  }
 
  // ===================== 重叠检测 =====================
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/overlap
   * 重叠检测聚合：时间冲突 + 资源争抢 + 依赖交汇（3 维度）。
   * Query: dimensions=time,resource,dependency & threshold=8
   */
  async getOverlap(
    projectId: string,
    user: AuthUser,
    dimensions?: string,
    threshold?: number,
  ) {
    await this.assertProjectVisible(projectId, user);
 
    const dimList: ('time' | 'resource' | 'dependency')[] = dimensions
      ? (dimensions.split(',').map(d => d.trim()) as any)
      : ['time', 'resource', 'dependency'];
 
    const resourceThreshold = threshold ?? 8;
 
    // 拉任务（非删除）
    const tasks = await this.prisma.task.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId, deletedAt: null },
      select: {
        id: true,
        title: true,
        status: true,
        assigneeId: true,
        startedAt: true,
        dueAt: true,
        estimatedHours: true,
      },
    });
 
    // 拉依赖
    const deps = await this.prisma.taskDependency.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, projectId },
      select: { id: true, prevTaskId: true, nextTaskId: true, isShared: true, type: true },
    });
 
    // 成员姓名
    const assigneeIds = [...new Set(tasks.map(t => t.assigneeId).filter(Boolean) as string[])];
    const members = assigneeIds.length > 0 ? await this.prisma.user.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: assigneeIds } },
      select: { id: true, displayName: true },
    }) : [];
    const nameMap = new Map(members.map(m => [m.id, m.displayName]));
 
    // 计算 CPM 拿 ES/EF（如果 dimensions 含 time/resource）
    // 简化：用 startedAt/dueAt 估算，没有 startedAt 就用 dueAt - estimatedHours/8 天
    const tasksForOverlap: TaskForOverlap[] = tasks.map(t => {
      let start: string
      let end: string
      if (t.startedAt) {
        start = toYMD(new Date(t.startedAt))
      } else if (t.dueAt && t.estimatedHours) {
        const durDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((t.estimatedHours as any).toNumber() / 8))
        const d = new Date(t.dueAt)
        d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - durDays)
        start = toYMD(d)
      } else if (t.dueAt) {
        start = toYMD(new Date(t.dueAt))
      } else {
        start = toYMD(new Date())
      }
      if (t.dueAt) {
        end = toYMD(new Date(t.dueAt))
      } else if (t.startedAt && t.estimatedHours) {
        const durDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((t.estimatedHours as any).toNumber() / 8))
        const d = new Date(t.startedAt)
        d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + durDays)
        end = toYMD(d)
      } else if (t.estimatedHours) {
        const durDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((t.estimatedHours as any).toNumber() / 8))
        const d = new Date()
        d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + durDays)
        end = toYMD(d)
      } else {
        end = start
      }
      return {
        id: t.id,
        title: t.title,
        assigneeId: t.assigneeId,
        assigneeName: t.assigneeId ? (nameMap.get(t.assigneeId) ?? t.assigneeId.slice(0, 8)) : undefined,
        start,
        end,
        estimatedHours: t.estimatedHours?.toNumber() ?? 0,
        status: t.status,
      }
    })
 
    const depsForOverlap: DependencyForOverlap[] = deps.map(d => ({
      id: d.id,
      prevTaskId: d.prevTaskId,
      nextTaskId: d.nextTaskId,
      isShared: d.isShared,
      type: d.type,
    }))
 
    const result = detectOverlaps(projectId, tasksForOverlap, depsForOverlap, {
      dimensions: dimList,
      resourceThreshold,
    })
 
    return { data: result }
  }
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/overlap/time
   * 时间冲突明细（仅 time 维度）。
   */
  async getOverlapTime(projectId: string, user: AuthUser) {
    const result = await this.getOverlap(projectId, user, 'time')
    return { data: result.data.dimensions.time }
  }
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/overlap/resource
   * 资源争抢明细（仅 resource 维度）。
   * Query: threshold=8
   */
  async getOverlapResource(projectId: string, user: AuthUser, threshold?: number) {
    const result = await this.getOverlap(projectId, user, 'resource', threshold)
    return { data: result.data.dimensions.resource }
  }
 
  /**
   * GET /reports/projects/:projectId/overlap/dependency
   * 依赖交汇明细（仅 dependency 维度）。
   */
  async getOverlapDependency(projectId: string, user: AuthUser) {
    const result = await this.getOverlap(projectId, user, 'dependency')
    return { data: result.data.dimensions.dependency }
  }
}
